原文: These are nice battery testers, but if you own a multi-meter, you probably don't need these. My multi-meter gives me the actual volts. These testers give you bars to indicate if something is bad or good. It is perfect for those who don't know how to use a multi-meter, and small enough to keep in the kitchen drawers. In my experience, in terms of accuracy, it's more about the gadget, and not the tester. For example, my dish soap dispenser stopped working, but all the AAA batteries tested as GOOD on these testers, not 100%, but still good. So does this mean these testers are bad? No, not at all. I put the batteries in my remote controls and they work. So the tester was right, there is still juice in them. The soap dispenser is just a battery hog. Once the battery drains a bit, it's hungry for fresh batteries. So this is what I mean when I say it's more about the gadget than the tester. Not complicated at all to use, so perfect for anybody in your household who doesn't like tools or complicated tech. 5-Stars!

This cable REPLACES the one that comes in Raspberry Pi kit combinations from most sellers. They don't state that clearly in the description (maybe I missed it). I thought I was buying the shorter one available that plugs into the kit cable then into the Pi. Thing you need to have to use this is a USB power plug just like the ones for iPhone and other USB devices. I'd give it 5 stars if they clearly stated this. I'd still buy it but I'd have started searching the house for spares before it arrived.

A word about powering the Pi units: I also used a powered USB port expansion hub as recommended by one kit provider. I also use HDMI output. After shutting down the op system on the Pi, I noticed the unit was not fully powered down. This traced back to both the powered USB expansion hub and the HDMI cable as well, both of which seem to supply power to the unit at some level. Recommend turning off power to the USB expansion and, if needed, unplugging the HDMI cable should you need to open the Pi and pull out the memory or other connected devices.

关于给树莓派供电的一点说明：我还按照一个套件供应商的建议使用了一个有源USB端口扩展集线器。我也使用HDMI输出。在关闭树莓派上的操作系统后，我注意到设备并没有完全断电。这追溯到有源USB扩展集线器和HDMI线缆，两者似乎都在某种程度上向设备供电。建议关闭USB扩展的电源，如果需要，拔掉HDMI线缆，以防你需要打开树莓派并拔出内存或其他连接的设备。

原文:
These fit the iPod Nano very snuggly. A few problems do exist though. They are very fragile and will tear easily which is unfortunate since you have to partially remove it to plug the nano in for recharging. I've already ripped 2 skins and I expect the 3rd will eventually get ripped too. Also, it's a little hard to see through the skin portion which goes over the nano screen and it attracts lint and small fuzzies which makes it look kind of dirty.

A really good thing though is if you can keep from ripping it up and don't mind the lint and don't really need to read the screen, is the fact that the arm band goes through it nicely. I wear mine a lot when I jog/run and since that's what I bought the skins for I really don't have a lot to complain about. They do what I want them to do.
中文翻译:
这些非常贴合iPod Nano。不过确实存在一些问题。它们非常脆弱，容易撕裂，这很不幸，因为你必须部分取下它才能插入Nano进行充电。我已经撕坏了2个保护套，预计第3个最终也会被撕坏。此外，覆盖在Nano屏幕上的保护套部分有点难以看清，而且它容易吸附棉絮和小绒毛，让它看起来有点脏。

不过一个非常好的地方是，如果你能避免撕坏它，不介意棉絮，并且不太需要看屏幕，那么臂带能很好地穿过它。我慢跑/跑步时经常佩戴我的，既然这就是我买这些保护套的目的，我真的没什么可抱怨的。它们做到了我想要的。

原文: These TeckNet cables came in just in time. I noticed that one of my usb micro cables wasn't charging my headphones and decided to investigate. I took a picture so I could show you what happened. The old usb micro cable was coming apart where it plugs into the device! With this six pack of 4 different lengths of cables, I should be back in business for some time. It pays to buy multiple cords because with kids, they go through them quickly and they don't unplug them by the ends, they just yank them out. I plugged in the longest one and immediately attached it to my headphones, I like the extra long cable, because I can charge my headphones while I listen to my podcasts or music while I sleep. The smaller ones are great to use on my laptop for a quick charge nearby. I am a happy camper right now. You never know where you might find your happiness. I found mine this morning in a small box from TeckNet.
中文翻译: 这些TeckNet数据线来得正是时候。我注意到我的一根USB Micro数据线无法给我的耳机充电，于是决定调查一下。我拍了张照片，以便向你们展示发生了什么。那根旧的USB Micro数据线在插入设备的地方裂开了！有了这六根装、四种不同长度的数据线，我应该能撑上一段时间了。多买几根线是值得的，因为有了孩子，他们很快就会把线弄坏，而且他们不会捏着插头拔，而是直接拽出来。我插上了最长的那根，立刻接上了我的耳机。我喜欢超长的线，因为我可以一边听播客或音乐一边给耳机充电，甚至睡觉时也行。短一些的线很适合在笔记本电脑旁边快速充电。我现在是个快乐的露营者。你永远不知道在哪里能找到幸福。今天早上，我在TeckNet的一个小盒子里找到了我的幸福。

原文:
This review is for the 35 foot length cable.

This is THE ONLY cable over 25 feet I've found that will transmit the PS4 Pro's signal @ 4k. When set to YUV420, the signal is crystal clear, but it does struggle a bit to push the full RGB 4k signal (I start to see "sparkles" / noise artifacts). Keep in mind however, no other cable over 25 feet will even transmit the 4k YUV420 signal.

There are clearly Leprechauns working away inside these cables!

Now, if only they made a 30 foot version...
中文翻译:
这条评论是关于35英尺长度的线缆。

这是我找到的唯一一条超过25英尺且能传输PS4 Pro的4K信号的线缆。当设置为YUV420时，信号非常清晰，但在推送完整的RGB 4K信号时确实有点吃力（我开始看到“闪烁”/噪声伪影）。但请记住，没有其他超过25英尺的线缆甚至能传输4K YUV420信号。

这些线缆里面显然有矮妖在干活！

现在，要是他们能做一个30英尺的版本就好了……

原文:
This is a very big P&S camera case. It will probably fit the biggest P&S cameras. The dimensions in the description are the internal dimensions. The external seams and heavy padding give the case some huge external dimensions: 6"x4"x2.5". This thing won't fit in your pocket.

Construction quality is not as good as similar cases from LowePro or Kata, but it is a good value at $6, which is half what the name brands cost.

做工质量不如LowePro或Kata的类似保护套，但6美元的价格很划算，是名牌价格的一半。

原文: I bought this camera so I can see my dogs when I let them outside. Turns out, it's become quite the necessary! I see things going on at my house when I'm at work or when I hear a noise outside at night, I just open the app on my phone to see what's out there. The motion detector will notify you each time it takes a shot when it senses movement, so I had to turn that off (since we have a lot of windy days and nights here). Rain will also trip the motion detector. You still get all the pics (just not the pings) when you turn that feature off. I love this camera!, and it was fairly easy to install after picking a spot to install it. I might even get a second one to install on the other side of the yard.

原文:
These are good walkie-talkies. I like the flexibility as far as power. We use the rechargeable batteries to save money, but you can use AA also. I also like that because when my son goes camping, he can bring extra batteries so it lasts longer. It has a lot of weather information, which is good, especially when camping.

这些很容易使用。它们与其他FRS/GMRS对讲机兼容，这对我们来说很棒。我们有各种各样的这类对讲机，而且是一个大家庭。我认为它们工作得相当好。它们清晰，并且有相当好的范围。我也真的很喜欢micro-USB充电选项。这些对成人和孩子都很好。它们相当容易使用。我会推荐它们。

原文:
These glasses are the perfect gift for the minecrafters in your family. We've only been playing mine craft since the summer and already it's become a favorite. When my hubby and son figured out they could play a 3-D version, we pulled out the paper 3-D glasses that came in a box of cereal. Quickly it became evident that if we were going to use the 3-D function, we'd have to get better glasses.

First off, I didn't realize there were so many different kids of 3-D glasses, some are red and blue, like these, and some are red and green, which means there are two images, a red image for one eye and a blue image for the other eye. When Jaws 3-D came out there was an urban legend that if you didn't have the 3-D glasses, the movie would be invisible. Crazy and completely untrue.

But the newer kind of 3-D, like what you see if you watch a newer 3-D movie (like the upcoming Star Wars) uses a new system, called polarization (two projections of the movie are shown and your eyes are fed both images simultaneously, creating a 3-D effect), for a polarized movie you get those black glasses they give you when you buy a movie ticket.

Those black glasses will not work on an old style red/blue or red/green 3-D game or movie (we checked, just to make sure!).

My only complaint with these glass are the fit, they slide around a bit and on my son, they slide down a lot. But other than that, they are great.
中文翻译:
这些眼镜是送给家里《我的世界》玩家的完美礼物。我们从夏天才开始玩《我的世界》，它已经成了最爱。当我丈夫和儿子发现可以玩3D版本时，我们拿出了麦片盒里附带的纸质3D眼镜。很快我们就发现，如果要使用3D功能，就得买更好的眼镜。

首先，我没想到3D眼镜有这么多不同种类，有些是红蓝的，就像这些，有些是红绿的，这意味着有两个图像，一只眼睛看红色图像，另一只眼睛看蓝色图像。当《大白鲨3D》上映时，有个都市传说说如果没有3D眼镜，电影就会看不见。这很疯狂，完全不是真的。

但较新的3D类型，比如你看较新的3D电影（比如即将上映的《星球大战》）时看到的，使用了一种新系统，叫做偏振（电影的两个投影同时显示，你的眼睛同时接收两个图像，产生3D效果），对于偏振电影，你会得到买电影票时发的那些黑色眼镜。

那些黑色眼镜在旧式红蓝或红绿3D游戏或电影上不起作用（我们检查过，只是为了确认！）。

我对这些眼镜唯一的意见是贴合度，它们会滑动一点，在我儿子脸上，它们会滑下来很多。但除此之外，它们很棒。

I love this thing! I only returned it because I didn’t get it in time for my travel and searched high and low for any local stores to sell them and I found 1! Prices were pretty much the same everywhere online.

I went through my carrier, Verizon and sure you can get a jet pack or some mobile WiFi device but you still have to pay monthly charges (like a mobile phone) which isn’t worth it for me. I don’t travel often so I don’t want to pay for something I won’t be using.

This device is awesome! You don’t need a SIM card which seemed like a requirement for other mobile WiFi devices during my search. They have many plans you can choose from or pay as you go. It’s wireless and charged fully quickly. You can track your usage and purchase more data (if you’re not on an unlimited plan). Once you’ve used up data, you’re cut off so there’s no surprise overage costs.

The app for me wasn’t as user friendly but support was available right away via app. I they believed there was a glitch with mine. The remaining data kept changing (significantly) at first. After resetting it, seemed to fix the problem.

I didn’t see an option to have users enter password every time. My kids set their devices to auto connect so they would connect without knowing (if I didn’t check usage). This drained my data. The other negative thing I would say is that it tells you how many devices are connected but not who or what is connected unless I just didn’t see the option (again, not user friendly to me). All this is minor given my research on what was available.

Why didn’t I use my Verizon hot spot? I wanted to make sure I was able to connect without issues and upload/download without issues. My experiences with the 4g hot spot was terrible. The 5G isn’t as bad (but I didn’t know that since I had just upgraded my phone).

我通过我的运营商Verizon，当然你可以得到一个jet pack或一些移动WiFi设备，但你仍然需要支付月费（像手机一样），这对我来说不值得。我不经常旅行，所以我不想为我不使用的东西付费。

"installation" couldn't be easier
1) plug it in to the wall
2) cable it to your stereo with the attached cable/wire
3) pair it with your bluetooth device
4) play your music

My review is limited to connecting via my Apple devices: a Touch and a laptop. Both worked without any issues whatsoever. I noticed that some reviewers have said they need to repair each time; I haven't experienced that problem. [[VIDEOID:5f99a990ea71fc33e4d54b09c37038e2]] EDIT January 2023: I originally complained that Bluetooth used to only reconnect to the last phone used. This is an issue with all of their Android powered head units apparently, as the S8 did the same. However, I'm happy to say that customer support came though with a modified firmware that FIXED the problem! It will try to connect to the last device, but if not found will move on to connect to other previously-paired phones, as expected. I am now very happy with the unit for the asking price. Definitely would recommend!

Originally review follows:
Before I go into what I don't like, let me tell you what this product is:
This is a buttonless edition of their popular A6 PF head unit. I can't tell if it is identical to the button version internally, but if you like the look of a smooth bezel-less design, this is the head unit to try!
I have tried and owned a few of their devices and largely love what you can get for the money. That's not even counting that their customer support has been EXTREMELY responsive! However there is one major user experience problem I just can't get past which makes it hard to recommend this to my friends.
If you are the only driver of your car, you'll likely never know or care about this, but all of Atoto's Android powered units (S8 included) will only pair automatically with the last phone used. That means if you share the car with other family members, and they drove the car last, your phone won't auto-connect next time you drive. It will be stuck looking for THAT phone (the last one) in perpetuity. You had to manually go into the settings for BT1 and find the list of paired phones, then click on yours, and THEN it will connect. Only to repeat this process the next time someone else drives and wants their phone to connect. It's silly, honestly. Their F7 doesn't do this, but the S8 also did. Most name-brand head units will move on to the next device in their paired list if the last one isn't found, I don't see why this device can't do that. They claimed it has something to do with security and specifically with Android units (which would be why the F7, based on linux does not have this limitation?). It does not make any sense to me and is a complete user experience failure, to the point that my wife has told me she might want us to go back to our old OEM head unit- at least that one would auto-connect to whoever is driving the car, regardless of who drove it last!
See attached video for demonstration.
中文翻译:

以下是原评论：
在我谈论我不喜欢的地方之前，让我告诉你这个产品是什么：这是他们流行的A6 PF主机的无按钮版本。我无法判断它内部是否与按钮版本相同，但如果你喜欢光滑无边框设计的外观，这就是值得尝试的主机！
我试过并拥有过他们的几款设备，很大程度上喜欢你能以这个价格得到的东西。这甚至还不算他们的客户支持一直非常响应迅速！然而，有一个主要的用户体验问题我无法忽视，这使得我很难向我的朋友推荐这个。
如果你是车里唯一的司机，你可能永远不会知道或关心这一点，但所有Atoto的安卓主机（包括S8）都只会自动与最后使用的手机配对。这意味着如果你与其他家庭成员共用汽车，而他们最后开了车，那么你下次开车时，你的手机就不会自动连接。它会一直寻找那个（最后一个）手机。你必须手动进入BT1的设置，找到配对手机列表，然后点击你的手机，然后它才会连接。只是下次别人开车并想要连接他们的手机时，又要重复这个过程。老实说，这很愚蠢。他们的F7不会这样做，但S8也会。大多数名牌主机如果找不到最后一个设备，会继续尝试配对列表中的下一个设备，我不明白为什么这个设备不能这样做。他们声称这与安全有关，特别是与安卓设备有关（这就是为什么基于Linux的F7没有这个限制？）。这对我来说毫无意义，完全是用户体验的失败，以至于我妻子告诉我，她可能想让我们回到旧的OEM主机——至少那个会自动连接到开车的人，无论上次是谁开的！
见附带的视频演示。

原文:
Most USB wall chargers these days can handle the commonly used international voltages. The problem is the prongs that fit into the wall outlets. If you travel a lot internationally, this is a great product for you. The documentation says it handles USA, Australia, UK, and European standards. All the Asian countries that I have visited use these plug configurations as well (usually the US or EU styles, possibly with different voltages, but this plug handles that as well).

Many cheaper multi-plug converters are very flimsy and don't last long. This one is sturdier than most.

Really nice to have the USB sockets (including USB-C) built in, though the USB-C port unfortunately does not support USB Power Delivery fast charging. For people traveling light, this little gadget is all you need.
中文翻译:
如今大多数USB壁式充电器都能处理常用的国际电压。问题在于插入墙壁插座的插脚。如果你经常国际旅行，这对你来说是个很棒的产品。文档说明它支持美国、澳大利亚、英国和欧洲标准。我去过的所有亚洲国家也使用这些插头配置（通常是美国或欧盟样式，可能电压不同，但这个插头也能处理）。

许多更便宜的多插头转换器非常脆弱，用不了多久。这个比大多数都更坚固。

内置USB插座（包括USB-C）真的很不错，不过USB-C端口遗憾的是不支持USB Power Delivery快速充电。对于轻装旅行的人来说，这个小工具就是你所需要的。

原文:
Modem works fine but activation was a nightmare. Appears to be faster and more stable across multiple devices than my old SB5100. The first speedtest I did got me a full 55Mbps (max for my level of service).
Time Warner online activation communicated with the modem but then failed. This sent me to activation support where a polite lady in India wasted an hour of my time. Finally I got through to "level 3 tech support" and my modem was activated in less than 5 minutes. The issue was because the modem had been registered to a previous owner (refurbished -- duh!) and the activation needed a lvl 3 tech authorization to move it from one account to the next (kicker is that it was likely TWC who sold these refurbs in the first place!).
Please learn from my mistake, try the online activation if you like but if it fails after already recognizing your new modem (step 2), give up and call TWC "level 3 tech support." Make sure you have the MAC # which is on the bottom of the modem.
Or if you have any alternative to TWC then do yourself a solid and switch providers.
中文翻译:
调制解调器工作正常，但激活过程简直是噩梦。在我的多个设备上，它似乎比旧的SB5100更快、更稳定。我第一次测速就得到了完整的55Mbps（我的服务等级的最高速度）。
时代华纳的在线激活与调制解调器通信了，但随后失败了。这让我进入了激活支持，一位在印度的礼貌女士浪费了我一个小时的时间。最后我接通了“三级技术支持”，我的调制解调器在不到5分钟内就被激活了。问题在于调制解调器之前已经注册给前一个所有者（翻新机——废话！），激活需要三级技术授权才能将其从一个账户转移到另一个账户（讽刺的是，很可能就是TWC最初卖出了这些翻新机！）。
请从我的错误中吸取教训，如果你愿意可以尝试在线激活，但如果它在已经识别到你的新调制解调器后（第2步）失败了，就放弃并致电TWC的“三级技术支持”。确保你有MAC号码，它在调制解调器的底部。
或者，如果你有任何替代TWC的选择，那就帮自己一个忙，换供应商吧。
